limitations: Focus/selection/identity evidence is Linux/jsdom. Real Node/Vite HTTP and built workerd preview are verified separately; neither proves browser appearance.
No manual desktop/mobile browser, screenshot, Windows execution or deployment evidence.
Node Todo storage remains in-memory; Worker /api/todos stays 404 until M05b. M05c/d/M06 durable authority and live integration remain pending.
Scalar completion retains DOM; conditional/list lifetimes retain nodes until explicit owner/lifetime disposal. External DOM removal does not automatically dispose owners.
State accumulation is shared; pure selectors execute per view consumer. There is no global atomic DOM commit or animation scheduling claim.
Reconciliation retains identities and minimizes DOM writes; no universal throughput/performance claim.
Final PR-head CI is recorded in the PR; no automatic merge or later milestone advancement.
